en.title: Download and Open the JAGS Installer
en.description:
This function downloads the JAGS installer that matches the operating system and R version
(see `cmsy_jags_versions()` and `cmsy_download_jags()`), checks its size and checksums, and
opens it: the `.exe` installer on
Windows and the `.pkg` installer on macOS. On Linux it downloads the source code and shows
how to install JAGS with the package manager or from source. An installer placed in the
package folder `inst/jags/` (installed as `jags/`) is used instead of downloading.
en.value: Invisibly, the path of the downloaded installer.

arguments.version: The JAGS version: "recommended" (default), "latest" or a version number.
arguments.os:
The operating system whose settings are used: "auto" (default, detect it),
"windows", "macos" or "linux".
arguments.open: A logical value. If TRUE (default), the installer is opened.
arguments.data_dir: The directory where downloads are kept. Default is `fao_data_dir()`.
arguments.silent:
A logical value. If TRUE, no summary is printed. Default is FALSE, or the value
set with `fao_settings(silent = )`.

zh.title: 下载并打开JAGS安装程序
zh.description: 本函数下载与操作系统和R版本匹配的JAGS安装程序（见`cmsy_jags_versions()`和`cmsy_download_jags()`），核对文件大小和校验值，然后打开它：Windows上是`.exe`安装程序，macOS上是`.pkg`安装程序。在Linux上则下载源代码，并说明如何用包管理器或从源代码安装JAGS。如果在包的`inst/jags/`文件夹（安装后为`jags/`）中放有安装程序，则直接使用该文件，不再下载。
zh.value: 以不可见方式返回所下载安装程序的路径。

arguments.os: 采用哪个操作系统的设置："auto"（默认，自动检测）、"windows"、"macos"或"linux"。
arguments.open: 逻辑值。为TRUE（默认）时打开安装程序。
arguments.data_dir: 下载文件的保存目录。默认为`fao_data_dir()`。
arguments.silent: 逻辑值。为TRUE时不输出汇总信息。默认为FALSE，或`fao_settings(silent = )`设置的值。
